trades.name: Failed reclaim of 28945-28969
trades.quote: Any kind of failure from buyer to reclaim 28945-28969 is objectively a continuation short targeting 742 and 663. It seems like “chasing” but given the potential for a continued liquidation break I can rate it a B-.

trades.name: Fail in 29339-29378
trades.quote: Short a fail in the 29339-29378 range looking broadly for Friday’s low. 257 and arguably 234 would need to be lost (and a session downtrend of course) to find Friday’s low and continuation lower. B+
trades.stop_hint: 257 and arguably 234 would need to be lost (and a session downtrend of course) to find Friday’s low and continuation lower.

trades.name: Fail/LAAF of 29469-29487
trades.quote: Short a fail/LAAF of 29469-29487. Things will look awfully bullish if we see this area but if we are to see fresh initiative sellers (aside from those longs liquidating) then this would be the area. The primary target would be 339-378 with potential for renewed liquidation. Again, it would still need to trigger a downtrend but given the outsized potential for downside continuation from here I have to rate it highly. A/A+.
trades.stop_hint: it would still need to trigger a downtrend

trades.name: LBAF of 28945-28969
trades.quote: I’m willing to look for longs on a LBAF of 28945-28969. This is a bit awkward since NQ bled out well lower after the bell. I’m trying to write a plan that could survive all night and Monday’s cash session. The bottom line is that failure to proceed lower (from the weekly plan and above) invites structural repair. I’ll be careful on an initial reclaim but if sellers then fail to get back through it I will take a shot.
trades.stop_hint: I’ll be careful on an initial reclaim but if sellers then fail to get back through it I will take a shot.

trades.name: Front-run reclaim: failed push through 28800-28817 / 28742-28763
trades.quote: I will also add that I am narrowly open to considering front running a reclaim. We have the 800-817 weekly level and the 742/763 prior weekly lows. Any kind of failed push through these spots which triggers a session uptrend likely retests Friday’s low. If it then reclaims Friday’s low then things can get spicy. I would categorize any kind of bottom fishing in this manner as low probability and extremely high reward.
trades.stop_hint: With a low probability and high reward trade I personally size smaller and use tighter stops even if I wait for some kind of session trend reversal confirmation.
